descriptions.w3d_d24k_gauge_setup_80265d34: Gauge panel setup: forwards the context service to the panel base, reads FE.BorderThickness through a handle (0x800fc1b0) into +556 and +560 (0.7x), clamps the limits at settings +128/+124 to [0,100] with write-back, runs 0x802663dc and 0x802672cc, reads the optional named value with watcher 0x8026836c, calls the optional root service slot 23, applies the value through 0x802683b8, subscribes to messages 0x804b0aac/0x804b0ab4, resets with 0x80268568, stores the context service in +492 and releases the handle.
